basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old amateur baker from the UK, currently working as a part-time sailing instructor. I recently discovered Reddit and quickly got hooked on exploring various communities. I love sharing my baking experiments and learning new recipes from around the world. When I'm not on the water or in the kitchen, you might find me watching the latest episodes of the Great British Bake Off. I'm single and live in a small coastal town, which gives me easy access to the sea. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, with a cup of tea in hand.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in baking comes from years of self-teaching through online classes, cookbooks, and experimentation in my kitchen. As for sailing, I started at a young age, taking lessons at my local sailing club, and eventually became a certified instructor.
